name: Hygge Hotel
paymentPlan: 20% down payment at sales launch; 60% paid during construction; 20% paid on handover
overview: Hygge Hotel is located within the prestigious Heart of Europe development, offering a unique hospitality concept inspired by the Danish philosophy of “hygge”—the art of enjoying life’s simple pleasures and cultivating warmth, comfort, and connection. Situated on Dubai’s iconic World Islands, this premium project merges European charm with Middle Eastern luxury, providing a sanctuary where guests can escape the ordinary and embrace mindful indulgence.
